recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: a logging glitch threatening to devour terabytes of disk space
bond markets opening a live window for the first time
the largest buried cache unearthed beneath an australian bunker
fog rolling through san francisco before dawn
summer solstice week settling into long golden evenings
closed-door talks adjourning with quiet optimism

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Tap on stuttered house beat drops to punch holes through rolling fog — each hit reveals golden streetlights on a san francisco hill, synced to fred again-style kick slices.
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: one 30-second drop loop that feels like a perfect club moment compressed into a thumb workout.
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: BPM stutters accelerate, missed beats thicken the fog until the screen is nearly opaque.
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: neon wireframe over grayscale fog banks

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Flick proliferating log fragments off a drowning SSD before they stack into terabyte towers — each chunk bounces with physics and multiplies if it lands wrong.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: chain-reaction clears are cathartic; one good flick can wipe half the screen in seconds.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: fragments spawn exponentially, gravity inverts mid-round, fragments merge into heavier blobs.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: terminal green phosphor on black, CRT scanlines

claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.concept: Draw fog-dispersal paths for dawn commuters crossing a muted dream-pop cityscape — drag to carve corridors, release and mist slowly refills the gaps.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.session_hook: each round delivers one satisfying golden corridor from hilltop to waterfront before fog wins.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.escalation: wind shifts decay speed unpredictably, pedestrian clusters multiply, paths narrow as fog thickens.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.aesthetic: watercolor dream pop — dusty rose, sea glass, fog gray

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Swipe between three underground bunker lanes collecting sealed crates while tunnel supports crumble — a one-thumb heist timed to melodic techno pulses on the walls.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: single-screen runs under 60 seconds with compounding crate values and near-miss tunnel collapses.
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: ceiling debris falls faster, rare crates appear in the most dangerous lane, heat-map warnings pulse red.
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: paper cutout cross-section, amber torchlight and ink shadows
